prompt: Polished Roblox-style mining simulator, stylized 3D game render, no UI, no text other than icons. World 2 underground rest hall: a large rock cavern deep underground where a desert mining colony has built a tech base. It is always dark down here: no sunlight, the cave is lit only by the base's own lamps, light strips and glowing elements, with deep shadowy rock beyond. Art direction: BIG FLAT COLOUR BLOCKS, chunky rounded simple shapes, few large readable masses, smooth plastic-toy surfaces, matching a surface colony of glossy white domes and bright yellow machinery. Floor: ONE smooth continuous poured floor (no tiles, no grid, no paving seams) with a few very wide painted lanes and huge painted arrows. Layout of every hall: a square open mine shaft (16 m wide) in the centre with a low yellow guard rail where the player keeps digging down, a small ore-buying counter with a big ore-chunk icon, a round teleport station pad with a glowing ring, and a big name board on the far wall. Camera: third-person view from behind a small blocky miner with a pickaxe at the edge of the hall, looking across the shaft. Theme 'automated mine tunnel': yellow conveyor belts carrying ore chunks along the walls, big yellow drill arms bolted into the rock, white machine housings, orange warning stripes, cool white flood lights on tall posts. Rock: warm brown-orange. Accent glow: warm white and amber.
